description: Unified action/subaction router for Unraid server operations: system inspection, management operations, live telemetry, and destructive actions gated by explicit confirmation.

action.description: Action group: system, health, array, disk, docker, vm, notification, key, plugin, rclone, setting, connect, customization, subscriptions, or help.

confirm.description: Must be true to run a destructive subaction.

params.description: Parameters for the subaction (named in the per-group documentation), e.g. container_id, vm_id, disk_id.

subaction.description: Operation within the action group, e.g. overview, list, start, stop.

name: unraid
